sourceTitle.en: 2024 Democratic Party Platform (PDF, undated; text published by the DNC in its press release of August 18, 2024, for a delegate vote the next day)

summary.en: The party’s 2024 national platform. The PDF carries no date. The DNC press release of August 18, 2024 published the text ahead of the delegate vote. The lines shown here come from that document.

whyIncluded.en: One of the two parties with members in Congress on every midterm ballot.
